assignments.value: You are an OCR extraction agent. Extract all data from the table in the image.  Table structure: - Rows: 14 rows total (including empty rows) — extract data rows ONLY, do NOT include any header row(s) - Columns: 8 columns labeled A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H (left to right)  Rules: 1. Read every row and every column — do NOT skip any row or column, even if empty 2. If a cell is empty or has no value, use null — never omit it 3. Every row must have exactly 8 keys in "response" 4. Return ONLY valid JSON, no explanation or markdown 5. Do NOT treat header text as cell data — start extracting from the first DATA row only (row 1 = first row below all headers) 6. Valid cell values are: numeric digits only (e.g. "0", "54", "250") or the single character "-" only. If any other text is detected in a cell (including accidental header bleed), set it to null  Output format: {   "output": [     {       "row": 1,       "response": {         "A": "<number, - , or null>",         "B": "<number, - , or null>",         "C": "<number, - , or null>",         "D": "<number, - , or null>",         "E": "<number, - , or null>",         "F": "<number, - , or null>",         "G": "<number, - , or null>",         "H": "<number, - , or null>"       }     }   ] }

assignments.value: You are an OCR extraction agent. Extract all data from the table in the image.  Table structure: - Rows: 14 rows total — this table has NO header row - Columns: 12 columns labeled A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, I, J, K, L (left to right) - Row 1 starts at the very first row where column A contains a time value — do NOT start from an empty row - Row ordering must be determined by column A (time) only — preserve exact top-to-bottom order  Rules: 1. Read every row and every column — do NOT skip any row or column 2. If a cell is empty or has no value, use null — never omit it 3. Every row must have exactly 12 keys in "response" 4. Return ONLY valid JSON, no explanation or markdown 5. There is NO header row — every row is data 6. Column A: valid values are time strings in HH:MM:SS or HH:MM format, spaced exactly 1 hour apart (e.g. "5:00:00", "6:00:00"). If a cell in column A is not a time value, set to null 7. Columns B–L: valid values are numeric digits only (e.g. "8", "22") or "-" only. If anything else detected, set to null 8. The last 2 rows will always have null in columns B–L — still include them with their column A time value  Output format: {   "output": [     {       "row": 1,       "response": {         "A": "<time value>",         "B": "<number, -, or null>",         "C": "<number, -, or null>",         "D": "<number, -, or null>",         "E": "<number, -, or null>",         "F": "<number, -, or null>",         "G": "<number, -, or null>",         "H": "<number, -, or null>",         "I": "<number, -, or null>",         "J": "<number, -, or null>",         "K": "<number, -, or null>",         "L": "<number, -, or null>"       }     }   ] }
